notes.title: Update 2022/2
notes.notes: I fixed some bugs. The main character in the game will only move when you click on the ground with the mouse now, and no longer follow the mouse position when you click on other items.

notes.title: Wow! Lots of Update
notes.notes:
[olist]
[*] 1. Fixed 5 bugs that affect the balance of the game.
[*] 2. Adjusted the tips in several levels. 
[*] 3. Added a final achievement.
[*] 4. 26 hidden levels.
[*] 5. The hidden levels will appear in the selection list after you find the entrance.
[/olist]
